picker-view

Picker embedded in the page. Only the picker-view-column component can be placed. Other nodes are not displayed.

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
value Array No Sequence numbers of the picker-view-column components in the picker-view in sequence (the subscript starts from 0). If the number is greater than the length of the picker-view-column option, the last option is selected.
indicator-style String No Style of the check box in the middle of the picker.
indicator-class String No Style class of the check box in the middle of the picker.
mask-style String No Style of the mask layer.
mask-class String No Style class of the mask layer.
bindchange eventHandle No Triggers the change event during scrolling selection. The output is event.detail = {value}. {value} is an array, indicating the sequence number (the subscript starts from 0) of the picker-view-column in the picker-view.
bindpickstart eventHandle No Triggers an event when the scroll selection starts.
bindpickend eventHandle No Triggers an event when the scroll selection ends.

Sample Code


<view>
    <view>Embed page scroll selector</view>
    <view>
        <view>
            <picker-view style="height: 500px;width: 100%;text-align:center;">
                <picker-view-column>
                    <view>2013</view>
                    <view>2014</view>
                    <view>2015</view>
                    <view>2016</view>
                    <view>2017</view>
                    <view>2018</view>
                    <view>2019</view>
                    <view>2020</view>
                </picker-view-column>
                <picker-view-column>
                    <view>Q1</view>
                    <view>Q2</view>
                    <view>Q3</view>
                    <view>Q4</view>
                </picker-view-column>
            </picker-view>
        </view>
    </view>
</view>


Page({
  data: {},
  onChange(e) {
    console.log(e.detail.value);
    this.setData({
      value: e.detail.value,
    });
  },
});
